# pidginhost_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key stored on the account, for installing on new servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_ssh_key" "admin" {
  alias = "admin"
  key   = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format. Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Label shown for the key. The API picks one when left empty.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object in the PidginHost API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an SSH key by its numeric id.
terraform import pidginhost_ssh_key.admin 123
```
